title: Create the default.css theme
body:
Since we are starting to remove all require(.css) from the JS, to provide easy theming customization:

* \[x] create it in themes/default.css (add BREAKING CHANGE note about CSS loading for integrators)
* \[x] enhance build task to minify all css (scripts/build.sh) and put both unminified and minified in dist/themes/default.\[min].css
* \[x] update doc to inform on how to load it from jsdelivr
* \[x] ~~update doc to inform on how to load it from npm (location: instantsearch.js/themes/default.css)~~
* \[x] publish to jsdelivr (nothing to do here but a release, it will be automatically accessible on cdn.jsdelivr.net/instantsearch.js/0/themes/default.min.css)
* \[x] remove webpack loaders linked to css loading (and shrinkwrap: https://gist.github.com/vvo/d3c1c3d4358309ed2619)

@pixelastic I had to write this out of my head, feel free to edit :)
